tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.asura_iron_: The smallest denomination in the wealthy Asura Kingdom.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.asura_coppe: Standard copper coin of Asura. Equals 10 iron coins.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.asura_large: The primary commerce coin of the civilized world. Worth a hearty meal.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.asura_silve: Valuable silver coin of merchants and nobles. Equals 10 large copper.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.asura_gold_: Pure imperial gold coin. Provides a comfortable living for months.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.demon_scrap: Scrap iron fragment. Common loose change on the harsh Demon Continent.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.demon_stone: Hand-chiseled stone coin of demon tribes. Equals 10 scrap iron.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.demon_large: Heavy carved stone slab with demon seal. Standard Adventurer Guild pay.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.demon_green: Precious faceted coin of rare jade ore. A true fortune on the Demon Continent.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.millis_copp: Sanctified church copper coin of the Holy Land of Millis.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.millis_silv: Pure silver coin engraved with the holy sun cross. Equals 100 copper.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.millis_gold: Sacred gold solidus of high clergy and holy knights of Millis.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.begaritt_co: Jingling brass and copper of desert caravans and labyrinth bazaars.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.begaritt_si: Nomadic silver coin engraved with ancient labyrinth compass runes.
tooltip.mushokucurrency.desc.begaritt_go: Ancient sun gold of dungeon conquerors and Begaritt merchants.
dialogue.mushokuguild.exchange_menu: The Guild provides currency exchange between continents. Local currency: %s. What would you like to exchange?
dialogue.mushokuguild.exchange_to_local: Exchange foreign currency to local currency
dialogue.mushokuguild.exchange_split: Break down large coins into smaller ones
dialogue.mushokuguild.exchange_fuse: Combine small coins into larger ones
dialogue.mushokuguild.exchange_done: Exchange completed successfully! A pleasure doing business with you.
dialogue.mushokuguild.exchange_no_funds: You do not have enough coins for this exchange.
